text: Ladies and gentlemen, the one who owns the whole building just stepped into the ring! They call this pressure fighter The Landlord. Tonight the Landlord sharpened the brain, not the body: a counter-grappler that the judge says matches its description. The model is unchanged, so the Realism Score holds at 38, same as last time. Want to climb, boss? Fix that neck seam, that rippled off-shoulder shirt, and that painted-on hair. In the charcoal rash guard and white hand wraps, give it up for THE OWNER!
